title: microsteer-traffic-quarantine-and-steward-rotation-playbook-wip
body:
Purpose:
This is a working playbook for small-batch activations where we need an automated quarantine gate + a human-in-loop steward rotation. Focus is on short-lived micro-exposures (0.1%–5%) for LLM-driven features where behavioral drift, latency regressions, and cost spikes are primary risks.

Scope and assumptions:
- Applies to hosted + dedicated routes; private deployments may adopt with perimeter changes.
- Assumes routing support for slice-level isolation, dynamic weight updates, and per-route telemetry.
- Not a full canary design doc — this is the operations playbook for the exposure window and recovery gating.

Quick summary (TL;DR):
1) Create micro-slice and nominate steward.
2) Start with synthetic probe + 1% live traffic ramp to micro-slice for 30m.
3) Automated quarantine monitors check thresholds every 60s. If any threshold trips, traffic immediately quarantined to fallback variant and steward notified.
4) Steward runs triage checklist, escalates if unresolved after 15m.
5) Rotate steward after each activation wave (24h rotation recommended).

Roles and responsibilities:
- Steward (primary): owns real-time monitoring for the micro-slice, executes recovery steps and comms. Usually product-ops or oncall PM/engineer.
- Backup steward: second contact if primary not reachable.
- Routing operator (infra): applies quick rollback at the infra level if automated mitigation fails.
- Data observability (SRE/Observability): ensures metric ingestion and dashboards for the wave.
- Experiment owner (product): owns hypothesis and acceptance criteria.

Nominate steward template (short):
- Name: <first-last>
- Pager/Slack: <handle>
- Backup: <first-last>
- Activation window: start/end
- Go / No-go criteria summary line

Activation flow (detailed):
1) Preflight (pre-activation, +1h):
   - Confirm model/runtime variant pinned. Link model id and rollout config in the activation ticket.
   - Run prioritized synthetic probe set (see probe-suite-2025.csv) against both primary and variant. Capture diffs.
   - Confirm telemetry lines (latency p50/p95/p99, error-rate, token-cost-per-response, hallucination-rate by eval prompts) are on dashboard.
   - Communication: announce activation window in #rollouts at T-30m.

2) Wave 0 — Synthetic-only (10m):
   - Send synthetic probes at 1x expected QPS for 10m. Ensure no regressions.

3) Wave 1 — Micro live traffic (0.1%–1%, 30m):
   - Ramp to target weight over 3 minutes.
   - Monitor automated quarantine monitors. If safe after 30m, and hypothesis requires, proceed to Wave 2.

4) Wave 2 — Micro extended (1%–5%, 2h):
   - Larger sample for behavioral signals, cost profiling. Explicit approval required from experiment owner and steward.

Automated quarantine logic (what trips the gate):
- Latency: p99 increases by > 200ms over baseline for 3 consecutive minutes.
- Error rate: 5xx or model-timeout increase to > 0.5% absolute or 3x relative baseline (whichever is smaller) for 2 minutes.
- Cost: per-token cost > baseline + 25% sustained for 15m.
- Behavior: hallucination-rate (from eval prompts) increases by +4 percentage points absolute or >50% relative for 30m.
- Safety/Sensitive outputs: any policy infractions flagged by classifier at >0.1% raw rate in micro-slice for 10m.
- Sample size guard: require >=1000 live requests in the window for behavior signals to count; otherwise degrade to investigation mode.

When gate trips:
- Immediately set micro-slice weight to 0 and route to fallback variant.
- Post a herald to #rollouts and @steward with short reason (metric + timeseries snapshot link).
- Create a triage issue (JIRA-RWINF-xxxx) with automated attachments (top 10 request traces, model id, runtime logs).

Steward triage checklist (first 15 minutes):
- Verify signal: open dashboard, confirm metric is from micro-slice and not global artifact.
- Validate synthetic probes: re-run focused probes against the variant and baseline.
- Check resource utilization on serving nodes (GPU mem, host load).
- Check recent deploys/infra changes (git reflog, infra-ops notes).
- If obvious cause (bad model weight, miscompiled kernel), coordinate rollback to last good model.
- If unknown and impacting user experience, escalate to oncall SRE and product owner.

Escalation timeline and comms:
- 0–15m: Steward only; updates every 5m in the triage ticket.
- 15–45m: If unresolved, page SRE oncall. Provide links and recent traces.
- 45–90m: Exec-level comms if user-facing impact broad; prepare rollback plan and customer comms draft.

Steward rotation policy (experimental):
- Daily rotation for critical waves (morning shift steward, evening backup).
- Rotation handoff document: short 3-line status, outstanding risks, contact list.
- Handoffs should be done in #rollouts with explicit ack from incoming steward.

Simulation harness (notes to devs):
- repo: github.com/redwood-inference/rollout-sim
- run: python simulate_wave.py --policy microsteer --traffic 0.01 --duration 1800
- simulations should inject latency spikes, rare timeouts, and synthetic hallucination signals (we use labeled eval set).
- output: time series CSV + artifacts/trace-links.json for injection into dashboards.

Quick recovery playbook (if quarantine triggered):
1) Day-0 safe rollback: set micro-slice weight to 0, confirm fallback.
2) Short-term mitigation: reduce concurrency, enable smaller token cap per call if cost spike.
3) Root-cause collection: collect 500 request traces (head), collect model metadata and runtime kernel logs.
4) After 2h, if unresolved, revert to last known good model on all routes and run retrospective.

Comms templates (core message snippets):
- Short alert to #rollouts: "[QUARANTINE] microsteer wave: p99 +230ms over baseline; weight set to 0. Steward @priya-pp triaging. Triage: <ticket_link>"
- Customer-facing (draft): "We briefly quarantined a small subset of requests due to performance anomalies while testing a model variant. No broad user impact; we rolled traffic back to our validated model and are investigating."

Post-activation retrospective (after wave ends):
- 24h report by steward: include metrics (p50/p95/p99 latency, error-rate, token-cost), top user-impacting cases, suggested guardrail changes.
- Add experiments that failed to the Experiment Failure Log (JIRA-RWINF-EXFAIL).
- Update probe suite with failing prompts; mark them as high-priority regression tests.

Open questions / TODOs (for product + infra):
- Should we relax the sample size guard for very latency-sensitive features? tradeoff between false positives vs missing regressions.
- Consider building an automated lightweight rollback (if p99 > X and steward not acknowledged in 2m). Safety implications.
- Need a lightweight UI in Console to show who is current steward and to click-to-quarantine.
- Automate creation of triage tickets with attachments from the quarantine event.

Appendix: quick checklist (printable)
- [ ] Steward nominated and acked
- [ ] Synthetic probe run baseline ok
- [ ] Dashboards linked in ticket
- [ ] Slack comms scheduled
- [ ] Activation ticket created with model id + runtime config
- [ ] Post-activation retrospective assigned

Notes to self (informal):
- Watch for oscillation when automatically quarantining small slices — added hysteresis to 3m windows helps.
- We should record an example handoff in the first two rotations to smooth process.
- Need to sync with dedicated infra team about per-tenant cost telemetry (they have a lag right now).

References and links (working):
- README for probe-suite: confluence:probe-suite-2025
- Simulation repo: github.com/redwood-inference/rollout-sim
- Past incident: JIRA-RWINF-789 (canary latency oscillation, Aug 2024)

End of draft.
